name: Government Polytechnic College, Kota
affiliated_to: Board of Technical Education Rajasthan (BTER), Jodhpur
overview: Situated in Kota, the education capital of Rajasthan, this institution is surrounded by major thermal and nuclear power plants, chemical industries, and manufacturing zones, providing rich practical knowledge.
admission_process: Admissions through DTE Rajasthan centralized counseling on 10th merit.
eligibility: 10th pass with Science & Math with minimum 35%.
hostel_facilities: Boys hostel (120 capacity), Girls hostel (60 capacity), mess, sports amenities.
campus_facilities: Instrumentation labs, Process control simulator, Central workshop, Smart classrooms, High-speed internet.
